STATE: After commit 622280e (March 19 2026), these are open/fixed:

FIXED in 622280e:
- needsInputModeSwitchKey crash (deferred to main.async)
- Double mic tap (toolbar gesture + button both fire didTapMic → 2 recordings)
- Keychain read 4x redundantly in viewDidAppear — now cached
- Audio polling timer RunLoop .default → .common (was pausing during touch)
- UIColor.withAlphaComponent in waveform display link (210 allocs/sec → use bar.alpha)
- Uncached SF Symbol images for emoji/return keys added to KeyImages
- [weak self] missing in rotation timer and coordinator closures
- UserDefaults(suiteName:) re-created every call → lazy cached property

STILL OPEN (lower priority):
- Recursive stopRecording when relay expires overwrites caller's completion
- Pending transcript inserted before proxy ready → silently lost if proxy not ready (checkPendingTranscription)
- Language label ('EN') in spacebar has hardcoded black color — invisible in dark mode
- ~40 lines dead shadow code (isLiquidGlass always true)
- contentEdgeInsets deprecated iOS 15+ in RecordingOverlayView
- Bouncing dot CAAnimations not cleaned in deinit
- pollingTimer in KeyboardTranscriptionService not on .common RunLoop
